task.description: Diagnose root cause of entity_subsystem_test.zig EXP-202 failures (5 of 13) after rescoping.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified with file/line evidence
Confirmed via direct DB inspection (docker exec psql)

result.summary: Root cause: migrations/094_entity_subsystem.sql declares '-- scope: all_schemas' but its entity_type_instances/entity_record_latest CREATE TABLE statements are public.-qualified, so runForSchema()'s search_path mechanism never places them into tenant schemas (a public.-qualified statement ignores search_path; it is a no-op during every tenant pass since public.<table> already exists). src/entities/commands.zig queries both tables with an explicit tenant-schema prefix ({s}.entity_type_instances), so getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance fails with relation-does-not-exist against any SCHEMA-mode tenant, e.g. this workspace's tenant_default (confirmed via docker exec psql \d tenant_default.entity_type_instances -> 'Did not find any relation'). GBL-137 already backfilled these tables once (2026-08-08) but that one-time snapshot does not survive tenant reprovisioning -- this workspace's tenant_default was reprovisioned after GBL-137 last ran.
